system.name: Kareus
system.one_liner: a system that jointly reduces dynamic and static energy in large model training by overlapping communication and computation

components.name: Input
components.role: the workload and target latency provided to Kareus

components.name: Workload
components.role: the training workload to be analyzed

components.name: Partitions
components.role: kernel partitions automatically detected from the workload

components.name: Optimizer
components.role: runs multi-objective Bayesian optimization per partition, evaluated with the thermally stable profiler

components.name: Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization
components.role: searches candidate execution schedules per partition to optimize time and energy jointly

components.name: Thermally Stable Profiler
components.role: evaluates candidate schedules under thermally stable conditions

components.name: Iteration Frontier
components.role: table of per-partition time-energy frontier points (T1..Tn) with SM, Timing, and Freq settings

components.name: Training Runtime
components.role: executes the training iteration using the selected frontier configuration

components.name: Partitioned Overlap Execution Engine
components.role: runs partitions with computation/communication overlap according to the selected schedule

components.name: Frequency Controller
components.role: sets GPU frequency per partition as invoked by the execution engine

components.name: GPU
components.role: the GPUs executing the training iteration

content.key_idea: Kareus turns a workload and a target latency into per-partition time-energy frontiers via Bayesian optimization and a thermally stable profiler, then executes training using the selected frontier configuration with a partitioned overlap execution engine and frequency controller.
content.reading_order: Top-left Input flows right into the Optimizer (Partitions, then Bayesian Optimization and the Thermally Stable Profiler), down into the Iteration Frontier table (also fed by Target Latency), and down into the Training Runtime's execution engine, frequency controller, and GPUs.

summary: This figure gives Kareus's end-to-end system overview as a numbered, three-panel pipeline. An Input panel supplies a Workload and Target Latency. The Workload flows (step 1) into an Optimizer panel where Partitions are detected and a Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization module proposes candidate execution schedules, evaluated by a Thermally Stable Profiler (step 2). The optimizer produces an Iteration Frontier table listing per-partition time-energy trade-off points (T1..Tn) with SM allocation, timing, and frequency settings (steps 3-4, combined with the target latency). This frontier configuration is passed (step 5) to a Training Runtime panel, where a Partitioned Overlap Execution Engine runs the training iteration on GPUs and invokes (step 6) a Frequency Controller to apply the selected per-partition GPU frequency. Pastel orange/green/blue panel coloring and dashed borders group the three stages, while circled numbers trace the pipeline from input to execution.
summary_zh: 该图展示Kareus系统总览：输入(工作负载与目标延迟)经步骤1进入优化器检测分区，步骤2用多目标贝叶斯优化与热稳定分析器评估候选方案，得到步骤3-4的迭代前沿表，再于步骤5-6交由训练运行时的分区重叠执行引擎与频率控制器在GPU上执行。
